results.name: disposable PostgreSQL 16 migrated through the journal (incl. 0007) and the API is healthy behind the proxy with no provider configured
two synthetic invoices saved by the operator
one follow-up due now (Northwind) and one upcoming (Vienna Cafe) saved through the real API
operator signs in through the browser
Nudgey keeps its quick actions and the follow-up scheduler and adds 'Ask Nudgey'
the Ask view shows five example chips, a labelled input limited to 200 characters, and focuses the input
an empty prompt cannot be submitted (Ask is disabled) and makes no request
four bounded POST /api/invoice-drafts/search requests, one per PayPal draft group, each with status and limit 5 in the BODY
the real invoices appear under 'No PayPal draft' with their own currency and exact total; other groups say None; no payment claim
exactly one search POST whose BODY carries q='Northwind Studio'; the URL has no query string and the name appears in no URL
only the matching customer is shown
the currency is sent to the server as a filter (EUR) and only EUR records are shown with no cross-currency total
a fresh GET /api/follow-ups; the due follow-up (Northwind) is shown with its Manila time and zone, the upcoming one is not
it says a due follow-up does not mean the invoice is unpaid
upcoming shows only Vienna Cafe
payment status is refused truthfully and offers saved/draft details instead
the refusal and an unknown request made zero network requests
the first search was held until replacement, then canceled; only the newer question and USD-filtered answer remain
Open invoice opens the real saved-invoice page and closes Nudgey
reopening Nudgey shows an empty conversation (nothing kept after close)
signing out removes the workspace and the whole conversation from the page
signing in again works
after sign-in the conversation is empty again
at 390px the panel is fully inside the viewport, above the mobile navigation, with no horizontal page overflow
only auth, invoice search/detail and follow-up reads were used: never parse, PayPal-draft, a follow-up write, or any send route
no request left the page origin and no URL contains customer text
no PayPal operation, no PayPal id, no approval or webhook row; only the two seeded follow-ups exist (the chat wrote nothing)
browser storage is empty, the page URL has no query or hash, and the only console errors are the pre-sign-in 401 session probes
the audit log has no free-text question or customer name
